title: Take a look inside Steam Deck™!
summary: Valve opens up a Steam Deck to show its internal components and explain which are replaceable or upgradable. It advises against self-repair but shares the details openly.
why: HN praises its openness and respect for the customer, and cites it as a precedent for manufacturers showing internals.

quote.text: I haven't seen anything so pro-consumer from a major electronics manufacturer in years.
